description: High-speed multi-train excitation for railway bridges. PT60 model (Project InBridge4EU / passenger trains selection) is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Pedro Museros, Carlos Riascos (Universitat Politècnica de València). This dataset contains a train model named PT60, which comprises a total of 60 different passenger trains among conventional (CB), articulated (AB) and regular types (SA). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
